as_told.title: Charles Hall lived with the tall whites

plain: In the 1960s, a man named Charles Hall, whom Michels calls a colonel and a whistleblower, says he lived for years alongside tall, white alien beings while stationed at Indian Springs Valley in Nevada. Michels brings Hall up on three different episodes, once saying he had just interviewed him. In those later tellings he places it at Area 51, the secret Air Force test site in Nevada, instead of Indian Springs.
